title: The Collection Pavilion
summary: After the fight, the Tang family decides it must not provoke Xu Mu, thinking a Corporeal Yang this strong could only have been trained by the Xu family of Planet Dong Lin. In the underground cave beneath the immortal market, Wang Lin notices that the tunnels form runes; Li Yuan works out that nine such tunnels make a huge healing formation that has run for ages, keeping someone alive. A voice inside offers Wang Lin any immortal art if he has Li Yuan open the seal, and drives Li Yuan half mad, but Wang Lin refuses a free gift and they flee. Chased by a crimson Ji Realm force that floods his sea of consciousness, Wang Lin holds it with origin power and keeps part of it sealed inside himself for later, while the sealed being cries out for Qi Condensation cultivators and swears that Qing Shui's day of death is coming. A month and a half later they see crowds heading to four fragment continents where immortal power has surged; Zhan Konglie, now a Thunder Celestial Temple envoy, greets Wang Lin respectfully and hears about the Three Heroes of the South. At the realm's center, Li Yuan finds the hidden restriction of the Collection Pavilion and uses his Heart Restriction to send Wang Lin inside, where the four guardians of the four families, among them a Yao family Corporeal Yang guardian, say outsiders may not enter; Wang Lin fights them until they ask whether he is now qualified.

553-563: Wang Lin recalls only one person who broke past Nascent Soul with a Ji Realm, one received as a gift from a friend (likely Ma Liang).
